doc: Shared/merged memory conflicts (Letta #4832/#5091 + the 0.33.0 git-conflict repair): a teammate's clone carries a committed project.md (seed rules + Manual notes) while the local engine already has overlapping platform state. The verbatim import must not duplicate or clobber: overlapping facts stay single, Manual notes survive, and the render is stable across a re-import (idempotent).

checks.name: importing a project.md whose bullets overlap existing platform memories creates no duplicates

evidence.lane: local engine (scope already holds overlapping platform state)

checks.name: the '## Manual notes' section from the file survives the import and the render

evidence.lane: teammate clone (empty scope — the import runs)
evidence.render:

checks.name: a second identical import is a no-op (idempotent counts)

findings: fm-10: importLegacyMarkdown itself has NO content-level dedup — measured on an unguarded scope: 2 then 2 bullets imported, scope count 3 -> 5, the overlapping fact ends up in 3 memories. Production's only guard is the dream-time emptiness check (dream.ts imports a committed file into an EMPTY scope only). Any future call site that imports into a non-empty scope duplicates. Recommendation: hash-dedup inside importLegacyMarkdown. (Recorded as a finding, not a src edit — the no-benchmark-driven-edits constraint.)
